stem: Which statement would the speaker of the poem “Leaping Falls” most likely agree with that is NOT supported by the article “Acoustic Sculpture, Sound Art, and the Music of the Sea”?
instruction: Use “Acoustic Sculpture, Sound Art, and the Music of the Sea” and “Leaping Falls” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: Artistic experiences can be found in natural environments.

options.label: B
options.text: Encountering wonders in nature is a private and individual experience.

options.label: C
options.text: It takes hard work and dedication to complete an artistic project.

options.label: D
options.text: It is the responsibility of an individual to share insight about the natural world.
